messages:
sre-bot: ALERT hosted-gateway: spike in 5xx/504 for tenant 'evoke' — p95 2.9s, 504s +180 in 5m. dash: https://grafana.internal/d/ingress/hosted-gateway

mia (oncall): got it, also assigned from support. Customer says repeated 502/504 and timeouts hitting /v1/generate. They pasted a failing curl.

alex_support: sample from customer: `HTTP/2 504 {\"error\": \"gateway timeout\"}`. They report ~25-35% error rate across a group of keys.

oliver: infra metrics show request_queue_depth at gateway = 12,400 and continuous_batcher.pending = 12,000. batcher.max_queue_depth = 1,000. Lots of enqueue timeouts and "enqueue dropped" logs.

mia (oncall): that explains it — queue is way over capacity. Any recent config changes to batcher or gateway?

dean: no deploys in last hour. Looks like one tenant ramped traffic; KV-cache miss rate jumped too (x2) which increases per-token compute.

oliver: mitigation options: 1) soft-throttle tenant to 20-30 qps, 2) fallback to smaller model variant, 3) scale batcher replicas, 4) lower batch window. I'll run quick commands if we agree.

mia (oncall): do 1 + 2 immediately. Hold on scaling until we check worker memory. Alex, update the customer.

alex_support: messaging customer now: "We're seeing a tenant traffic spike causing queue saturation and timeouts. We've applied a temporary throttle and a smaller-model fallback while we investigate. Please reduce background worker concurrency; we'll follow up in ~15m."

oliver: running commands:
```
rbctl tenant throttle evoke --qps 25
rbctl rollout fallback-model evoke --model redwood-lg --percent 10
kubectl scale deploy/continuous-batcher -n hosted --replicas=6
```

platform-bot: NOTE: scaling request accepted; pods starting. Monitor for OOM.

dean: batch_window_ms is 18ms currently. Proposal: decrease to 10ms to reduce queueing at cost of smaller batches. Also consider increasing max_batch_size to absorb short spikes.

mia (oncall): applied throttle + 10% fallback canary. Watching. If we see queue < 1500 and 5xx drop to baseline, we'll revert throttle & rollback canary.

oliver: after throttle, gateway queue dropped to ~4.6k. 504s decreasing. continuous_batcher.pending now 4.2k. KV miss rate trending down after cache warmup.

alex_support: customer replied — they found a runaway background worker that exploded requests. They'll patch and cap to 20 qps per worker.

mia (oncall): follow-up plan:
- Keep throttle for 10 more minutes once metrics stable
- Monitor p95 target < 400ms before removing throttle
- Collect traces (enqueue/dequeue), batcher logs, KV-cache heatmaps for postmortem
- Consider automatic tenant throttling when queue depth exceeds threshold

oliver: one risk: scaling batcher gave more workers but each has higher memory usage due to more KV shards. Watching memory pressure. If OOMs appear we'll revert.

platform-bot: ALERT: continuous-batcher pod cb-5 restarted (OOMKilled) — under investigation. Rolling scaleback to 4 replicas while we confirm memory footprint.

mia (oncall): noted. Rolling scaleback to 4 replicas. Throttle still in place.

oliver: queue now 860, pending 820, 504s back to baseline. Can remove fallback and throttle in ~5-10m if stable.

alex_support: told customer we plan to remove throttle in 10m once they confirm patch. They acknowledged and will watch after they deploy the fix.

mia (oncall): closing steps: gather postmortem artifacts, review batch_window and auto-throttle policy, add a runbook step to detect runaway keys. I'll hand off to SRE team to write follow-up.

sre-bot: RESOLVED: hosted-gateway 5xx/timeouts mitigated for tenant 'evoke' at 3162278865.
